notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Walking Atlas.
Walking Atlas does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Amulet of Vigor.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Dimir Aqueduct.
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat.
